content: Yɛsu, un'te a vin a ndandaa
« Mɛ, mɛ in'wà un'te a vin a ndandaa, Taaràmɛ wà ŋawa.
Nde afàtsul kɔkà lanswà alà amu mɛ anà mpa làfàtwà, wɛɛ nde afàsaal la akwà làfàtwà, ntɔn la làbör mbɛŋ asin mbɔɔn.
Bɛ, bɛ làbà aŋàpɔŋà itaan ntɔn ndaa kàlakyään mɛ.

Làkäl amu mɛ, asànaa in'wà mɛ amu bɛ. Akà kɔkà làmwɛy làkwe anki mubɔr mbɛŋ la ŋakwo isàkal naa la kà là aŋànääm anki a mbiim a un'te, itàkal bɛ sye, bɛ làkwo anki mubɔr mbɛŋ, isàkal naa bɛ, bɛ làbà anki amu mɛ.
Mɛ, mɛ in'wà mbiim a un'te a vin, bɛ, bɛ làbà an'kɔkà. Mbuur awà amu mɛ, anà mɛ amu nde, nde afàbɔr mbɛŋ mbɔɔn. Ntɔn bɛ, bɛ làkwe anki mukyer akà undiir mwɛy ukɔɔn mɛ.
Mbuur mpa awà amu mɛ, nde wàŋàpiy u nsà, asànaa kɔkà, laa uyɔm nde. An'kɔkà aŋàyɔm bàkyer afàköŋà, bàtɔɔm u mbaa, waa ma ikuŋà.
Isàkal naa bɛ, bɛ làbà amu mɛ, ndaa amɛ sye yà amu bɛ, bɛ làsàlɔm undiir wanswà làsàkwen bɛ, bɛ làsàwal wa.
Ndaa ifàpà Taaràmɛ làkoo yà naa bɛ làbɔ̈r mbɛŋ mbɔɔn, waa bɛ làsàkal alɔŋki amɛ.
Abun, asànaa kan'kwen Taa, mɛ sye amàlakwen. Làkäl uboo a ukwen amɛ.
Isàkal naa bɛ làfàsyääl nswɛɛŋ amɛ, bɛ làbà uboo a ukwen amɛ, asànaa kàkwey mɛ nswɛɛŋ a Taaràmɛ, mɛ in'wà uboo a ukwen ande. »
« An'tɛn mɛ a bɛ abà, ntɔn un'sak amɛ ukäl uboo abɛ, anà wa sye ukäl wàŋàkwo.
Le nswɛɛŋ amɛ ayi: làkwen bɛ a bɛ asànaa in'fàlakwen mɛ.
Kà we anà mbuur mwɛy anki awe anà ukwen a kölàköl isàkɔɔn akal asànaa mukɔɔb mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande ntɔn asam ande.
Bɛ làbasam amɛ isàkal naa bɛ làfàkyer indiir in'fàlàswaŋ mɛ.
Mɛ alàbel anki asyääl, ntɔn un'syääl uyöb anki ayufàkyer nkum ande. Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ alabel asam, ntɔn ndaa yanswà kàwem mɛ akà Taaràmɛ, mɛ ya akyàlaswaŋ.
Kà bɛ anki lan'sɔ̈ɔ̈l, mɛ kàlasɔ̈ɔ̈l, mɛ kàlasi ntɔn bɛ làkyen, làbör mbɛŋ, waa mbɛŋ abɛ ilam. Abun, undiir wanswà làsàlɔm bɛ akà Taa kikɔb amɛ, nde akyer asàlapà wa.
Undiir alàswaŋ mɛ awà: làkwen bɛ a bɛ. »
Mɛɛn man'yiiŋ Yɛsu anà bànde
« Isàkal naa mɛɛn mà màmàlayiiŋ, làyöb naa mɛ in'wà mbuur atàtwɛb kàyiiŋ ma.
Ilàkal naa bɛ làkäl baar a mɛɛn, mɛɛn ikyer alàlakwen ntɔn bɛ làbà baar ama. Wɛɛ bɛ kà làbà baar ande anki: ntɔn kàlasi mɛ ukɔl, undiir awun mɛɛn màlayiiŋ ma.
Làyɔbà ndaa kàlakyään mɛ: "Un'lɔŋki ukwe anki ulyaŋ un'lɔɔŋ ande." Isàkal naa ba mɛ ban'mɛɛy nkwaaŋ, ba bɛ sye bàsàlamɛɛy nkwaaŋ. Isàkal naa ba bàkäär ndaa amɛ, ba bàsàkaar sye yàbɛ.
Wɛɛ indiir abi byanswà ba bàsàlakyer ntɔn ikɔb amɛ, ntɔn ba bàyöb anki mbuur kan'töm.
Ilàkal naa mɛ in'kɔ̈ɔ̈n ayà anà in'kɔ̈ɔ̈n akakyään, ba bàlàkal anki anà man'be. Wɛɛ apanà, ba undiir afàkur watɛy ntɔn man'be aba.
Mbuur kàman'yiiŋ, nde kan'yiiŋ sye Taaràmɛ.
Ilàkal naa mɛ in'kɔ̈ɔ̈n akàkyer isal abi uboboo a ba, isal mpa kàkwe mbuur asin mukyer, ba bàlàkal anki anà man'be. Apanà ba bàkyàman bya, wɛɛ ba bàmufiyiiŋ, mɛ anà Taaràmɛ.
Wɛɛ ya yà ntɔn ndaa bàsön uboo un'kɔɔn aba ikwe: "Ba ban'yiiŋ abunàbun." »
« Mpal usàyà un'lɛɛl in'sàlatööm mɛ kà ikɔb a Taa, Dweelà a ndandaa lan'fà akà Taa, nde asan'tɛɛl imbäl.
Anà bɛ sye, bɛ làsan'tɛɛl imbäl, ntɔn bɛ làbà anà mɛ fà nsɛmà. »
